text: Figure 2.2: The RTE instantiates for each ModeDeclarationGroupPrototype a Modema- chineInstance Previous versions of the Basic Software Modules especially the ECU state manager module have differentiated between ECU states and ECU modes. ECU modes were longer lasting operational ECU states that were visible to applications i.e. starting up, shutting down, going to sleep and waking up. The ECU Manager states were generally continuous sequences of ECU Manager module operations terminated by waiting until external conditions were fulfilled. Startup1, for example, contained all BSW initialization before the OS was started and terminated when the OS returned control to the ECU Manager module.
